title: Franco Grignani blog
lede: A blog about the designer Franco Grignani that frames its posts with his black and white graphics: a radial burst in the header and a band of diagonal stripes behind the cards.
summary: A black header with a white radial line burst and a striped portrait, above post cards on a field of diagonal black and white stripes.

evidence.note: Captured with `tools/capture.mjs` (headless Chrome, 1440 × 900) on 28 September 2026 and inspected. The screenshot shows the first viewport; the measurement covers up to four screens. The request for francogrignani.org redirected to this site. Nothing covers the page.

styles.note: Borderline: black and white radial lines and a diagonal stripe band carry the page, but a photographed face, a gold script signature, and card shadows are counter-traits.

context: Search results describe the blog as supervised by Daniela Grignani. This was not checked on the site itself. For the designer’s work, see the [Woolmark logo](ref:grignani-woolmark-logo-1964) and the [Alfieri & Lacroix page](ref:grignani-alfieri-lacroix-ad-1959).
observed: The header is solid black. At the left, white radial lines taper around an off-centre black hole, like a warped sunburst.

At the right, a photographed face is striped with light and shadow lines. At the centre, a gold handwritten signature sits over the line “the first blog about the man and the artist” in white sans-serif.
Below, a band of thick diagonal black and white stripes fills the page width. “the sign of our time” is set in black on a white label over the stripes.

White post cards with soft shadows sit on the stripe band: a black card with white condensed capitals, a black and white portrait, and a poster with red, green, and black stripes. A grey sidebar holds search and links.
A grey “Menu” button sits at the top left.
interpretation: The site borrows Grignani’s optical line work as page chrome. The diagonal stripe band behind the cards is the clearest op device on the page.
The screenshot is dark (palette lightness 0.27) while the CSS reads a white page (0.83), because the header and stripes are images. Card shadows give a shadow share of 0.16.
borrow: Put a band of heavy diagonal stripes behind a row of solid cards, so the pattern shows only in the gaps.
Use a warped radial burst of white lines on black as a header image.

images.alt: Franco Grignani blog home page: a black header with a white radial line burst at left, a gold signature at centre, and a striped portrait at right, above white post cards on a band of diagonal black and white stripes.
